description: Run a read-only SPARQL SELECT (or ASK) against the Wikidata Query Service. Prefixes wd:, wdt:, p:, ps:, pq:, rdfs:, schema:, wikibase:, bd: are predefined; use SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "de,fr,en". } for labels. Swiss hooks: wd:Q39 = Switzerland, wdt:P771 = BFS municipality code, wdt:P17 = country, wdt:P131 = located in. Example: SELECT ?m ?mLabel ?bfs WHERE { ?m wdt:P771 ?bfs . SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "de". } }. LIMIT 100 is injected when absent; larger LIMITs are clamped to 1000. 60 s timeout.
name: query_wikidata
title: SPARQL query on Wikidata
